title: Download the PlanQ app
subtitle: Never miss a work notification. Install PlanQ on your computer and phone for real-time alerts.

desktop.hint: Scan the QR code with your phone camera, or open the address below on your phone
desktop.or: To install on your phone too
desktop.qrAlt: QR code that opens the PlanQ app download page on your phone

inApp.title: You're already in the PlanQ app

notifyNote: The app supports real-time push notifications on Windows, Mac, iOS and Android.

androidPwa.stepChrome: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) at the top right and tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
androidPwa.stepSamsung: In Samsung Internet, open the menu (≡) at the bottom and tap "Add page to" → "Home screen".
androidPwa.stepConfirm: Tap "Install" and a PlanQ icon appears on your home screen.
androidPwa.installed: PlanQ is already installed on this device. Open it from the PlanQ icon on your home screen.
androidPwa.done: Installed. Launch PlanQ from your home screen.
androidPwa.dismissed: Installation was cancelled. You can tap it again anytime.
androidPwa.onPhone: Scan the QR code below with your Android phone to install right away.
androidPwa.storeSoon: Our Play Store app is in review — once it is live you can get it right here.

desktopPwa.label: This computer (Windows · Mac)
desktopPwa.installed: PlanQ is already installed on this computer. Open it from the Start menu or Dock.
desktopPwa.done: Installed. Launch PlanQ from the Start menu or Dock.
desktopPwa.dismissed: Installation cancelled. You can try again anytime.
desktopPwa.notReady: If it is already installed, use «Open in app» on the right of the address bar. Otherwise click the install icon (⊕) on the right of the address bar.
desktopPwa.otherBrowser: Open this page in Chrome or Edge to install it with one click.
